## Overview

This guide covers the complete deployment process for CoolProp WASM, from building the module to production deployment across different environments and frameworks.

### Deployment Checklist

- [ ] Build WASM module with appropriate optimization
- [ ] Configure web server for WASM MIME types
- [ ] Set up proper CORS headers
- [ ] Optimize file sizes and compression
- [ ] Configure CDN for global distribution
- [ ] Set up monitoring and error tracking
- [ ] Test across target browsers and devices
- [ ] Implement fallback strategies

## Build Process

### Prerequisites

```bash
# Install Emscripten
git clone https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk.git
cd emsdk
./emsdk install latest
./emsdk activate latest
source ./emsdk_env.sh

# Install CMake (3.15+)
# Install Python 3.6+
# Install Node.js (for testing)
```

### Build Configuration

#### Production Build (Size Optimized)

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# build_production.sh

# Set up environment
source /path/to/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh

# Create build directory
mkdir -p build_wasm_production
cd build_wasm_production

# Configure with production settings
cmake .. \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${EMSCRIPTEN}/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCOOLPROP_JAVASCRIPT_MODULE=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_OPTIMIZE_SIZE=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_ES6_MODULES=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_COMMONJS=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_CLOSURE_COMPILER=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_MINIFY=ON

# Build
cmake --build . --target coolprop --parallel $(nproc)

# Copy files to deployment directory
cp coolprop.js coolprop.wasm coolprop.d.ts ../deploy/
```

#### Performance Build (Speed Optimized)

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# build_performance.sh

cmake .. \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${EMSCRIPTEN}/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCOOLPROP_JAVASCRIPT_MODULE=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_OPTIMIZE_SPEED=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_ES6_MODULES=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_COMMONJS=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_SIMD=ON \
  -DCOOLPROP_WASM_THREADS=ON

cmake --build . --target coolprop --parallel $(nproc)
```

#### Debug Build

```bash
#!/bin/bash
```

### Automated Build Pipeline

#### GitHub Actions

```yaml
# .github/workflows/build-wasm.yml
name: Build CoolProp WASM

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        build_type: [production, performance, debug]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        submodules: recursive
    
    - name: Setup Emscripten
      uses: mymindstorm/setup-emsdk@v11
      with:
        version: latest
    
    - name: Configure CMake
      run: |
        mkdir build_${{ matrix.build_type }}
        cd build_${{ matrix.build_type }}
        
        if [ "${{ matrix.build_type }}" = "production" ]; then
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${EMSDK}/upstream/emscripten/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake \
            -DCOOLPROP_JAVASCRIPT_MODULE=ON \
            -DCOOLPROP_WASM_OPTIMIZE_SIZE=ON \
            -DCOOLPROP_WASM_ES6_MODULES=ON
        elif [ "${{ matrix.build_type }}" = "performance" ]; then
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${EMSDK}/upstream/emscripten/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake \
            -DCOOLPROP_JAVASCRIPT_MODULE=ON \
            -DCOOLPROP_WASM_OPTIMIZE_SPEED=ON \
            -DCOOLPROP_WASM_ES6_MODULES=ON
        else
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${EMSDK}/upstream/emscripten/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake \
            -DCOOLPROP_JAVASCRIPT_MODULE=ON \
            -DCOOLPROP_WASM_DEBUG_INFO=ON \
            -DCOOLPROP_WASM_SOURCE_MAPS=ON
        fi
    
    - name: Build
      run: |
        cd build_${{ matrix.build_type }}
        cmake --build . --target coolprop --parallel
    
    - name: Test
      run: |
        cd build_${{ matrix.build_type }}
        node ../wrappers/Javascript/test_basic.mjs
    
    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: coolprop-wasm-${{ matrix.build_type }}
        path: |
          build_${{ matrix.build_type }}/coolprop.js
          build_${{ matrix.build_type }}/coolprop.wasm
          build_${{ matrix.build_type }}/coolprop.d.ts
```

#### Docker Build

```dockerfile
# Dockerfile.build
FROM emscripten/emsdk:latest

WORKDIR /src
COPY . .

# Install dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    cmake \
    ninja-build \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Build production version
RUN mkdir build_production && cd build_production && \
    cmake .. \
      -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${EMSDK}/upstream/emscripten/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake \
      -DCOOLPROP_JAVASCRIPT_MODULE=ON \
      -DCOOLPROP_WASM_OPTIMIZE_SIZE=ON \
      -DCOOLPROP_WASM_ES6_MODULES=ON \
      -GNinja && \
    ninja coolprop

# Build performance version
RUN mkdir build_performance && cd build_performance && \
    cmake .. \
      -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${EMSDK}/upstream/emscripten/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake \
      -DCOOLPROP_JAVASCRIPT_MODULE=ON \
      -DCOOLPROP_WASM_OPTIMIZE_SPEED=ON \
      -DCOOLPROP_WASM_ES6_MODULES=ON \
      -GNinja && \
    ninja coolprop

# Copy outputs
RUN mkdir -p /output/production /output/performance && \
    cp build_production/coolprop.* /output/production/ && \
    cp build_performance/coolprop.* /output/performance/

VOLUME ["/output"]
```

## Deployment Strategies

### Static File Hosting

#### Basic Web Server Configuration

**Apache (.htaccess)**
```apache
# Enable WASM MIME type
AddType application/wasm .wasm

# Enable compression
<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
    AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/wasm
    AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/javascript
    AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/javascript
</IfModule>

# Set cache headers
<IfModule mod_expires.c>
    ExpiresActive On
    ExpiresByType application/wasm "access plus 1 year"
    ExpiresByType application/javascript "access plus 1 year"
</IfModule>

# CORS headers for cross-origin requests
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    Header set Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy "require-corp"
    Header set Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin"
    Header set Access-Control-Allow-Origin "*"
</IfModule>
```

**Nginx**
```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name your-domain.com;
    
    # WASM MIME type
    location ~* \.wasm$ {
        add_header Content-Type application/wasm;
        add_header Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy require-corp;
        add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy same-origin;
        
        # Cache for 1 year
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }
    
    # JavaScript files
    location ~* \.js$ {
        add_header Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy require-corp;
        add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy same-origin;
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }
    
    # Enable gzip compression
    gzip on;
    gzip_types
        application/wasm
        application/javascript
        text/javascript;
}
```

#### Node.js Express Server

```javascript
// server.js
const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const compression = require('compression');

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Enable compression
app.use(compression({
    filter: (req, res) => {
        if (req.headers['x-no-compression']) {
            return false;
        }
        return compression.filter(req, res);
    }
}));

// Set CORS headers
app.use((req, res, next) => {
    res.header('Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy', 'require-corp');
    res.header('Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy', 'same-origin');
    res.header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    next();
});

// Serve WASM files with correct MIME type
app.use('*.wasm', (req, res, next) => {
    res.type('application/wasm');
    next();
});

// Serve static files
app.use(express.static('public', {
    maxAge: '1y',
    immutable: true
}));

// Serve CoolProp files
app.use('/coolprop', express.static('dist/coolprop', {
    maxAge: '1y',
    immutable: true
}));

app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});
```

#### Cloudflare

```javascript
// Cloudflare Worker for WASM headers
addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  event.respondWith(handleRequest(event.request));
});

async function handleRequest(request) {
  const response = await fetch(request);
  
  // Add headers for WASM files
  if (request.url.endsWith('.wasm')) {
    const newResponse = new Response(response.body, response);
    newResponse.headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/wasm');
    newResponse.headers.set('Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy', 'require-corp');
    newResponse.headers.set('Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy', 'same-origin');
    newResponse.headers.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable');
    return newResponse;
  }
  
  return response;
}
```

### Container Deployment

#### Docker Production Image

```dockerfile
# Dockerfile.production
FROM nginx:alpine

# Copy built files
COPY dist/ /usr/share/nginx/html/

# Copy nginx configuration
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

# Add WASM MIME type
RUN echo 'application/wasm wasm;' >> /etc/nginx/mime.types

CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
```

#### Kubernetes Deployment

```yaml
# k8s-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: coolprop-wasm
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: coolprop-wasm
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: coolprop-wasm
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: coolprop-wasm
        image: coolprop/wasm:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "64Mi"
            cpu: "50m"
          limits:
            memory: "128Mi"
            cpu: "100m"

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: coolprop-wasm-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: coolprop-wasm
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
  type: LoadBalancer

---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: coolprop-wasm-ingress
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/add-base-url: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet: |
      add_header Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy require-corp;
      add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy same-origin;
spec:
  rules:
  - host: coolprop-api.yourdomain.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: coolprop-wasm-service
            port:
              number: 80
```

## Framework Integration

### React

#### Installation and Setup

```bash
# Create React app
npx create-react-app coolprop-react-app
cd coolprop-react-app

# Install CoolProp WASM
npm install coolprop-wasm
# or copy files to public directory
cp coolprop.* public/
```

#### React Hook for CoolProp

```javascript
// hooks/useCoolProp.js
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

export function useCoolProp() {
    const [coolprop, setCoolProp] = useState(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        let mounted = true;

        async function initCoolProp() {
            try {
                // Dynamic import to avoid SSR issues
                const CoolPropModule = await import('coolprop-wasm');
                const cp = await CoolPropModule.default();
                
                if (mounted) {
                    setCoolProp(cp);
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (mounted) {
                    setError(err);
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        initCoolProp();

        return () => {
            mounted = false;
        };
    }, []);

    const calculateProperty = useCallback((fluid, inputPair, value1, value2, outputProperty) => {
        if (!coolprop) return null;

        try {
            const state = new coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', fluid);
            state.update(inputPair, value1, value2);
            return state.keyed_output(outputProperty);
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Property calculation failed:', err);
            return null;
        }
    }, [coolprop]);

    return { coolprop, loading, error, calculateProperty };
}
```

#### React Component Example

```javascript
// components/PropertyCalculator.js
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useCoolProp } from '../hooks/useCoolProp';

export function PropertyCalculator() {
    const { coolprop, loading, error, calculateProperty } = useCoolProp();
    const [fluid, setFluid] = useState('Water');
    const [pressure, setPressure] = useState(101325);
    const [temperature, setTemperature] = useState(300);
    const [results, setResults] = useState(null);

    const handleCalculate = () => {
        if (!coolprop) return;

        try {
            const state = new coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', fluid);
            state.update(coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, pressure, temperature);

            setResults({
                density: state.rhomass(),
                enthalpy: state.hmass(),
                entropy: state.smass(),
                cp: state.cpmass(),
                viscosity: state.viscosity(),
                conductivity: state.conductivity()
            });
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Calculation failed:', err);
        }
    };

    if (loading) return <div>Loading CoolProp...</div>;
    if (error) return <div>Error loading CoolProp: {error.message}</div>;

    return (
        <div className="property-calculator">
            <h2>Thermodynamic Property Calculator</h2>
            
            <div className="inputs">
                <label>
                    Fluid:
                    <select value={fluid} onChange={(e) => setFluid(e.target.value)}>
                        <option value="Water">Water</option>
                        <option value="CarbonDioxide">CO₂</option>
                        <option value="Nitrogen">Nitrogen</option>
                        <option value="Propane">Propane</option>
                    </select>
                </label>
                
                <label>
                    Pressure (Pa):
                    <input 
                        type="number" 
                        value={pressure} 
                        onChange={(e) => setPressure(Number(e.target.value))}
                    />
                </label>
                
                <label>
                    Temperature (K):
                    <input 
                        type="number" 
                        value={temperature} 
                        onChange={(e) => setTemperature(Number(e.target.value))}
                    />
                </label>
                
                <button onClick={handleCalculate}>Calculate Properties</button>
            </div>

            {results && (
                <div className="results">
                    <h3>Results</h3>
                    <table>
                        <tbody>
                            <tr><td>Density</td><td>{results.density.toFixed(3)} kg/m³</td></tr>
                            <tr><td>Enthalpy</td><td>{results.enthalpy.toFixed(1)} J/kg</td></tr>
                            <tr><td>Entropy</td><td>{results.entropy.toFixed(1)} J/kg/K</td></tr>
                            <tr><td>Cp</td><td>{results.cp.toFixed(1)} J/kg/K</td></tr>
                            <tr><td>Viscosity</td><td>{results.viscosity.toExponential(3)} Pa·s</td></tr>
                            <tr><td>Conductivity</td><td>{results.conductivity.toFixed(4)} W/m/K</td></tr>
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}
```

### Vue.js

#### Vue 3 Composition API

```javascript
// composables/useCoolProp.js
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';

export function useCoolProp() {
    const coolprop = ref(null);
    const loading = ref(true);
    const error = ref(null);

    onMounted(async () => {
        try {
            const CoolPropModule = await import('coolprop-wasm');
            coolprop.value = await CoolPropModule.default();
            loading.value = false;
        } catch (err) {
            error.value = err;
            loading.value = false;
        }
    });

    return {
        coolprop,
        loading,
        error
    };
}
```

```vue
<!-- PropertyCalculator.vue -->
<template>
    <div class="property-calculator">
        <h2>CoolProp Property Calculator</h2>
        
        <div v-if="loading">Loading CoolProp...</div>
        <div v-else-if="error">Error: {{ error.message }}</div>
        
        <form v-else @submit.prevent="calculate">
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>Fluid:</label>
                <select v-model="fluid">
                    <option value="Water">Water</option>
                    <option value="CarbonDioxide">CO₂</option>
                    <option value="Nitrogen">Nitrogen</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>Pressure (Pa):</label>
                <input v-model.number="pressure" type="number" />
            </div>
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>Temperature (K):</label>
                <input v-model.number="temperature" type="number" />
            </div>
            
            <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
        </form>
        
        <div v-if="results" class="results">
            <h3>Results</h3>
            <table>
                <tr v-for="(value, key) in results" :key="key">
                    <td>{{ key }}</td>
                    <td>{{ formatValue(value) }}</td>
                </tr>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { useCoolProp } from '../composables/useCoolProp';

export default {
    name: 'PropertyCalculator',
    setup() {
        const { coolprop, loading, error } = useCoolProp();
        
        const fluid = ref('Water');
        const pressure = ref(101325);
        const temperature = ref(300);
        const results = ref(null);

        const calculate = () => {
            if (!coolprop.value) return;

            try {
                const state = new coolprop.value.AbstractState('HEOS', fluid.value);
                state.update(coolprop.value.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, pressure.value, temperature.value);

                results.value = {
                    'Density (kg/m³)': state.rhomass(),
                    'Enthalpy (J/kg)': state.hmass(),
                    'Entropy (J/kg/K)': state.smass(),
                    'Cp (J/kg/K)': state.cpmass()
                };
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Calculation failed:', err);
            }
        };

        const formatValue = (value) => {
            if (typeof value === 'number') {
                return value.toExponential ? value.toExponential(3) : value.toFixed(3);
            }
            return value;
        };

        return {
            coolprop,
            loading,
            error,
            fluid,
            pressure,
            temperature,
            results,
            calculate,
            formatValue
        };
    }
};
</script>
```

### Angular

#### Angular Service

```typescript
// services/coolprop.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { BehaviorSubject, Observable } from 'rxjs';

interface CoolPropModule {
    AbstractState: any;
    InputPairs: any;
    Parameters: any;
}

@Injectable({
    providedIn: 'root'
})
export class CoolPropService {
    private coolpropSubject = new BehaviorSubject<CoolPropModule | null>(null);
    private loadingSubject = new BehaviorSubject<boolean>(true);
    private errorSubject = new BehaviorSubject<Error | null>(null);

    public coolprop$ = this.coolpropSubject.asObservable();
    public loading$ = this.loadingSubject.asObservable();
    public error$ = this.errorSubject.asObservable();

    constructor() {
        this.initializeCoolProp();
    }

    private async initializeCoolProp(): Promise<void> {
        try {
            const CoolPropModule = await import('coolprop-wasm');
            const coolprop = await CoolPropModule.default();
            
            this.coolpropSubject.next(coolprop);
            this.loadingSubject.next(false);
        } catch (error) {
            this.errorSubject.next(error as Error);
            this.loadingSubject.next(false);
        }
    }

    public calculateProperties(
        fluid: string,
        pressure: number,
        temperature: number
    ): Observable<any> {
        return new Observable(observer => {
            const coolprop = this.coolpropSubject.value;
            
            if (!coolprop) {
                observer.error(new Error('CoolProp not initialized'));
                return;
            }

            try {
                const state = new coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', fluid);
                state.update(coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, pressure, temperature);

                const results = {
                    density: state.rhomass(),
                    enthalpy: state.hmass(),
                    entropy: state.smass(),
                    cp: state.cpmass(),
                    viscosity: state.viscosity(),
                    conductivity: state.conductivity()
                };

                observer.next(results);
                observer.complete();
            } catch (error) {
                observer.error(error);
            }
        });
    }
}
```

```typescript
// components/property-calculator.component.ts
import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CoolPropService } from '../services/coolprop.service';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

@Component({
    selector: 'app-property-calculator',
    template: `
        <div class="property-calculator">
            <h2>Property Calculator</h2>
            
            <div *ngIf="loading$ | async">Loading CoolProp...</div>
            <div *ngIf="error$ | async as error">Error: {{ error.message }}</div>
            
            <form *ngIf="!(loading$ | async)" (ngSubmit)="calculate()">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Fluid:</label>
                    <select [(ngModel)]="fluid" name="fluid">
                        <option value="Water">Water</option>
                        <option value="CarbonDioxide">CO₂</option>
                        <option value="Nitrogen">Nitrogen</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Pressure (Pa):</label>
                    <input [(ngModel)]="pressure" name="pressure" type="number" />
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Temperature (K):</label>
                    <input [(ngModel)]="temperature" name="temperature" type="number" />
                </div>
                
                <button type="submit">Calculate</button>
            </form>
            
            <div *ngIf="results" class="results">
                <h3>Results</h3>
                <table>
                    <tr *ngFor="let item of results | keyvalue">
                        <td>{{ item.key }}</td>
                        <td>{{ item.value | number:'1.3-3' }}</td>
                    </tr>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
    `
})
export class PropertyCalculatorComponent implements OnInit {
    loading$: Observable<boolean>;
    error$: Observable<Error | null>;
    
    fluid = 'Water';
    pressure = 101325;
    temperature = 300;
    results: any = null;

    constructor(private coolpropService: CoolPropService) {
        this.loading$ = this.coolpropService.loading$;
        this.error$ = this.coolpropService.error$;
    }

    ngOnInit(): void {}

    calculate(): void {
        this.coolpropService.calculateProperties(this.fluid, this.pressure, this.temperature)
            .subscribe({
                next: (results) => {
                    this.results = results;
                },
                error: (error) => {
                    console.error('Calculation failed:', error);
                }
            });
    }
}
```

#### Service Worker Caching

```javascript
// sw.js - Service Worker
const CACHE_NAME = 'coolprop-v1';
const COOLPROP_FILES = [
    '/coolprop.js',
    '/coolprop.wasm',
    '/coolprop.d.ts'
];

self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
    event.waitUntil(
        caches.open(CACHE_NAME)
            .then((cache) => cache.addAll(COOLPROP_FILES))
    );
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
    if (COOLPROP_FILES.some(file => event.request.url.endsWith(file))) {
        event.respondWith(
            caches.match(event.request)
                .then((response) => {
                    // Return cached version or fetch from network
                    return response || fetch(event.request);
                })
        );
    }
});
```

```javascript
// Lazy load CoolProp only when needed
class CoolPropLazyLoader {
    constructor() {
        this.coolpropPromise = null;
    }

    async getCoolProp() {
        if (!this.coolpropPromise) {
            this.coolpropPromise = this.loadCoolProp();
        }
        return this.coolpropPromise;
    }

    async loadCoolProp() {
        const CoolPropModule = await import('./coolprop.js');
        return await CoolPropModule.default();
    }
}

const coolpropLoader = new CoolPropLazyLoader();

// Use only when needed
document.getElementById('calculate-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const coolprop = await coolpropLoader.getCoolProp();
    // Perform calculations
});
```

## CDN and Distribution

### Multi-CDN Strategy

#### Primary CDN (AWS CloudFront)

```javascript
// cdn-config.js
const CDN_CONFIG = {
    primary: 'https://d1234567890.cloudfront.net',
    fallback: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/coolprop-wasm@latest',
    local: '/static/coolprop'
};

async function loadCoolPropWithFallback() {
    const urls = [
        `${CDN_CONFIG.primary}/coolprop.js`,
        `${CDN_CONFIG.fallback}/coolprop.js`,
        `${CDN_CONFIG.local}/coolprop.js`
    ];

    for (const url of urls) {
        try {
            const CoolPropModule = await import(url);
            return await CoolPropModule.default();
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`Failed to load from ${url}:`, error);
        }
    }
    
    throw new Error('Failed to load CoolProp from all sources');
}
```

#### Geographic Distribution

```javascript
// geo-cdn.js
function getCDNForRegion() {
    const timezone = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
    
    if (timezone.includes('America')) {
        return 'https://us-cdn.coolprop.org';
    } else if (timezone.includes('Europe')) {
        return 'https://eu-cdn.coolprop.org';
    } else if (timezone.includes('Asia')) {
        return 'https://asia-cdn.coolprop.org';
    }
    
    return 'https://global-cdn.coolprop.org';
}

const cdnUrl = getCDNForRegion();
```

## Performance Monitoring

### Real User Monitoring (RUM)

```javascript
// performance-monitor.js
class CoolPropPerformanceMonitor {
    constructor() {
        this.metrics = {
            loadTime: 0,
            initTime: 0,
            calculationTimes: [],
            memoryUsage: []
        };
    }

    startLoadTimer() {
        this.loadStartTime = performance.now();
    }

    endLoadTimer() {
        this.metrics.loadTime = performance.now() - this.loadStartTime;
        this.reportMetric('coolprop_load_time', this.metrics.loadTime);
    }

    startInitTimer() {
        this.initStartTime = performance.now();
    }

    endInitTimer() {
        this.metrics.initTime = performance.now() - this.initStartTime;
        this.reportMetric('coolprop_init_time', this.metrics.initTime);
    }

    measureCalculation(calculationFunc) {
        const startTime = performance.now();
        const result = calculationFunc();
        const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
        
        this.metrics.calculationTimes.push(duration);
        this.reportMetric('coolprop_calculation_time', duration);
        
        return result;
    }

    measureMemory() {
        if (performance.memory) {
            const memory = {
                used: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize,
                total: performance.memory.totalJSHeapSize,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            };
            
            this.metrics.memoryUsage.push(memory);
            this.reportMetric('coolprop_memory_usage', memory.used);
        }
    }

    reportMetric(name, value) {
        // Send to analytics service
        if (typeof gtag !== 'undefined') {
            gtag('event', name, {
                value: Math.round(value),
                custom_parameter_1: navigator.userAgent
            });
        }

        // Send to custom analytics
        fetch('/api/metrics', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                metric: name,
                value: value,
                timestamp: Date.now(),
                userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
                url: window.location.href
            })
        }).catch(console.error);
    }

    getReport() {
        return {
            ...this.metrics,
            avgCalculationTime: this.metrics.calculationTimes.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / this.metrics.calculationTimes.length,
            totalCalculations: this.metrics.calculationTimes.length
        };
    }
}

// Usage
const monitor = new CoolPropPerformanceMonitor();

// Monitor loading
monitor.startLoadTimer();
const CoolPropModule = await import('./coolprop.js');
monitor.endLoadTimer();

// Monitor initialization
monitor.startInitTimer();
const coolprop = await CoolPropModule.default();
monitor.endInitTimer();

// Monitor calculations
const result = monitor.measureCalculation(() => {
    const state = new coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', 'Water');
    state.update(coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, 101325, 300);
    return state.T();
});
```

### Error Tracking

```javascript
// error-tracker.js
class CoolPropErrorTracker {
    constructor() {
        this.setupGlobalErrorHandling();
    }

    setupGlobalErrorHandling() {
        window.addEventListener('error', (event) => {
            if (event.filename && event.filename.includes('coolprop')) {
                this.reportError({
                    type: 'javascript_error',
                    message: event.message,
                    filename: event.filename,
                    lineno: event.lineno,
                    colno: event.colno,
                    stack: event.error?.stack
                });
            }
        });

        window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => {
            if (event.reason && event.reason.message && 
                event.reason.message.includes('CoolProp')) {
                this.reportError({
                    type: 'promise_rejection',
                    message: event.reason.message,
                    stack: event.reason.stack
                });
            }
        });
    }

    reportError(errorInfo) {
        const errorReport = {
            ...errorInfo,
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
            url: window.location.href,
            coolpropVersion: this.getCoolPropVersion()
        };

        // Send to error tracking service
        fetch('/api/errors', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify(errorReport)
        }).catch(console.error);

        // Also log to console in development
        if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
            console.error('CoolProp Error:', errorReport);
        }
    }

    getCoolPropVersion() {
        // Try to extract version from module if available
        return '6.4.1'; // Or extract dynamically
    }
}

const errorTracker = new CoolPropErrorTracker();
```

## Troubleshooting Deployment Issues

### Common Deployment Problems

#### 1. WASM Loading Failures

**Problem:** WASM file fails to load or instantiate

**Diagnosis:**
```javascript
// Debug WASM loading
async function debugWASMLoading() {
    try {
        // Check if WebAssembly is supported
        if (typeof WebAssembly === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('WebAssembly not supported');
        }

        // Check if WASM file is accessible
        const wasmResponse = await fetch('./coolprop.wasm');
        if (!wasmResponse.ok) {
            throw new Error(`WASM file not found: ${wasmResponse.status}`);
        }

        // Check MIME type
        const contentType = wasmResponse.headers.get('content-type');
        console.log('WASM Content-Type:', contentType);

        // Try to compile WASM
        const wasmBytes = await wasmResponse.arrayBuffer();
        const wasmModule = await WebAssembly.compile(wasmBytes);
        console.log('WASM compilation successful');

        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('WASM loading failed:', error);
        return false;
    }
}
```

**Solutions:**
- Verify WASM MIME type configuration
- Check CORS headers
- Ensure WASM file is not corrupted
- Verify browser WebAssembly support

#### 2. CORS Issues

**Problem:** Cross-origin requests blocked

**Diagnosis:**
```javascript
// Check CORS headers
fetch('./coolprop.wasm', { method: 'HEAD' })
    .then(response => {
        console.log('CORS headers:');
        for (const [key, value] of response.headers.entries()) {
            if (key.toLowerCase().includes('cors') || 
                key.toLowerCase().includes('origin')) {
                console.log(`${key}: ${value}`);
            }
        }
    })
    .catch(console.error);
```

**Solutions:**
- Configure proper CORS headers
- Use same-origin deployment
- Set up proxy for development

#### 3. Memory Issues

**Problem:** Out of memory errors or poor performance

**Diagnosis:**
```javascript
// Monitor memory usage
function monitorMemory() {
    if (performance.memory) {
        const memory = performance.memory;
        console.log('Memory usage:', {
            used: `${(memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`,
            total: `${(memory.totalJSHeapSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`,
            limit: `${(memory.jsHeapSizeLimit / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`
        });
    }
}

setInterval(monitorMemory, 5000);
```

**Solutions:**
- Increase WASM memory allocation
- Implement object pooling
- Use Web Workers for heavy calculations

### Deployment Validation Script

```javascript
// validate-deployment.js
async function validateDeployment() {
    const tests = [
        {
            name: 'WebAssembly Support',
            test: () => typeof WebAssembly !== 'undefined'
        },
        {
            name: 'WASM File Accessible',
            test: async () => {
                const response = await fetch('./coolprop.wasm');
                return response.ok;
            }
        },
        {
            name: 'Correct MIME Type',
            test: async () => {
                const response = await fetch('./coolprop.wasm');
                const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
                return contentType === 'application/wasm';
            }
        },
        {
            name: 'Module Loading',
            test: async () => {
                const CoolPropModule = await import('./coolprop.js');
                return typeof CoolPropModule.default === 'function';
            }
        },
        {
            name: 'Module Initialization',
            test: async () => {
                const CoolPropModule = await import('./coolprop.js');
                const coolprop = await CoolPropModule.default();
                return coolprop && typeof coolprop.AbstractState === 'function';
            }
        },
        {
            name: 'Basic Calculation',
            test: async () => {
                const CoolPropModule = await import('./coolprop.js');
                const coolprop = await CoolPropModule.default();
                const state = new coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', 'Water');
                state.update(coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, 101325, 300);
                const T = state.T();
                return Math.abs(T - 300) < 0.01;
            }
        }
    ];

    console.log('🔍 Validating CoolProp WASM Deployment...\n');

    for (const { name, test } of tests) {
        try {
            const result = await test();
            console.log(result ? '✅' : '❌', name);
            if (!result) {
                console.log('   Validation failed for:', name);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.log('❌', name);
            console.log('   Error:', error.message);
        }
    }

    console.log('\n🏁 Validation complete');
}

// Run validation
validateDeployment().catch(console.error);
```

## Migration Guide

### From Previous CoolProp WASM Versions

#### Breaking Changes in v6.4.1

1. **Module Loading Pattern**
   ```javascript
   // Old (v6.4.0 and earlier)
   const coolprop = CoolProp();
   
   // New (v6.4.1+)
   const coolprop = await CoolPropModule();
   ```

2. **Enum Access**
   ```javascript
   // Old
   state.update(9, pressure, temperature); // Magic numbers
   
   // New
   state.update(coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, pressure, temperature);
   ```

3. **Error Handling**
   ```javascript
   // Old - Limited error information
   try {
       state.update(inputPair, value1, value2);
   } catch (error) {
       console.log('Error:', error.message);
   }
   
   // New - Enhanced error context
   try {
       state.update(inputPair, value1, value2);
   } catch (error) {
       console.log('Error:', error.message);
       console.log('Context:', error.context); // Additional context
   }
   ```

#### Migration Steps

1. **Update Module Loading**
   ```javascript
   // Step 1: Change synchronous to asynchronous loading
   async function migrateCoolProp() {
       // Old code
       // const coolprop = CoolProp();
       
       // New code
       const CoolPropModule = await import('./coolprop.js');
       const coolprop = await CoolPropModule.default();
       
       return coolprop;
   }
   ```

2. **Update Enum Usage**
   ```javascript
   // Step 2: Replace magic numbers with enum values
   function updateEnumUsage(coolprop, state) {
       // Old code
       // state.update(9, 101325, 300);
       
       // New code
       state.update(coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, 101325, 300);
   }
   ```

3. **Add TypeScript Support**
   ```typescript
   // Step 3: Add type definitions
   import CoolPropModule, { AbstractState, InputPairs } from './coolprop';
   
   const coolprop = await CoolPropModule();
   const state: AbstractState = new coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', 'Water');
   ```

#### Automated Migration Script

```javascript
// migrate-coolprop.js
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

function migrateCoolPropCode(filePath) {
    let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
    
    // Replace synchronous loading with asynchronous
    content = content.replace(
        /const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*CoolProp\(\)/g,
        'const $1 = await CoolPropModule()'
    );
    
    // Replace magic numbers with enum values
    const enumReplacements = {
        '9': 'coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value',
        '11': 'coolprop.InputPairs.PH_INPUTS.value',
        '12': 'coolprop.InputPairs.PS_INPUTS.value',
        '2': 'coolprop.InputPairs.PQ_INPUTS.value',
        '1': 'coolprop.InputPairs.QT_INPUTS.value'
    };
    
    for (const [oldValue, newValue] of Object.entries(enumReplacements)) {
        const regex = new RegExp(`\\.update\\(\\s*${oldValue}\\s*,`, 'g');
        content = content.replace(regex, `.update(${newValue}, `);
    }
    
    // Add import statement if not present
    if (!content.includes('import') && content.includes('CoolProp')) {
        content = `import CoolPropModule from './coolprop.js';\n\n${content}`;
    }
    
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content);
    console.log(`Migrated: ${filePath}`);
}

// Usage
const filesToMigrate = process.argv.slice(2);
filesToMigrate.forEach(migrateCoolPropCode);
```

### From Other Thermodynamic Libraries

#### From NIST REFPROP

```javascript
// REFPROP-style to CoolProp migration
class REFPROPToCoolPropAdapter {
    constructor() {
        this.coolprop = null;
    }

    async initialize() {
        const CoolPropModule = await import('./coolprop.js');
        this.coolprop = await CoolPropModule.default();
    }

    // REFPROP: TPRHO(T, P, x, iFlag)
    TPRHO(T, P, x, iFlag = 1) {
        const fluid = this.getFluidFromComposition(x);
        const state = new this.coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', fluid);
        
        if (x.length > 1) {
            state.set_mole_fractions_double(x);
        }
        
        state.update(this.coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, P, T);
        return state.rhomolar();
    }

    // REFPROP: TPFLSH(T, P, x)
    TPFLSH(T, P, x) {
        const fluid = this.getFluidFromComposition(x);
        const state = new this.coolprop.AbstractState('HEOS', fluid);
        
        if (x.length > 1) {
            state.set_mole_fractions_double(x);
        }
        
        state.update(this.coolprop.InputPairs.PT_INPUTS.value, P, T);
        
        return {
            D: state.rhomolar(),
            Dl: state.rhomolar_liquid(),
            Dv: state.rhomolar_vapor(),
            H: state.hmolar(),
            S: state.smolar(),
            U: state.umolar(),
            Cp: state.cpmolar(),
            Cv: state.cvmolar(),
            Q: state.Q()
        };
    }

    getFluidFromComposition(x) {
        // Map composition to fluid names
        // This would need to be customized based on your fluid mapping
        if (x.length === 1) {
            return 'Water'; // Default single component
        } else {
            return 'Methane&Ethane'; // Default mixture
        }
    }
}
```

This comprehensive deployment guide covers all aspects of building, deploying, and maintaining CoolProp WASM in production environments. It provides practical solutions for common deployment challenges and integration patterns for popular frameworks.
